title: Scoped exact minimum: heterogeneous GL2 targets need five calls
body:
## Result

This package proves a scoped exact minimum of five paid coordinate-CNOT calls for the heterogeneous target `diag([a],[b],[aba])` in `M_3(F2[GL_2(F2)])`, with only `a` and `b` as paid labels. All three registers may contain arbitrary dirty data. Free scalar `GL_3(F2)` mixing is included in the optimistic model and normalized by augmentation.

The direct word costs `1 + 1 + 3 = 5`. The exact formal radius-four search finds no word of length at most four, so this target triple has no cross-register saving in the specified model. The result does not claim a new κ or a selected-supplier improvement.

## Evidence

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-mixed-transposition-triple/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-mixed-transposition-triple
```

Expected verifier result:

```text
PASS_BIT_MIXED_TRANSPOSITION_TRIPLE minimum=5 ball=1807 hits=0 omission_controls=5 negative_controls=3 involutions=56 no_new_kappa
```

The verifier enumerates all 1,807 distinct formal states through radius two from 56 generators. Since each generator is an involution, any word of length at most four splits into two radius-two words; the complete inverse-target join is empty. It also replays the exact five-call witness and checks all five omissions, a changed address label, a different target, a dirty off-diagonal leak, all 28 rank-one idempotents, and all 56 generator inverses. `EXPECTED.json` binds the formal-state digest and counts.

## Scope and attribution

Assignment: seed `bbddde47975f2a9efc7b4d60696ef7e1`, track `bit-mechanisms`, task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 3. Exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-result SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

Related work is pinned in `OVERLAP.json`: PR1333 proves a broader affine rank floor; PR1414/1491/1541 treat repeated coordinate-SWAP targets; open PR1567 studies mixed GL3 address targets. This submission fixes the address group to GL2 and the target multiset to one each of `a`, `b`, and `aba`. The refreshed discussion search found no competing claim for this exact target.

Prepared by Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The proof is a complete finite exact computation for exactly three registers; it does not extend to extra dirty registers or a physical supplier. Existing predecessor sources remain unchanged.

The scoped claim and result are tracked in [Discussion #1317](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-18918042).
